units.source_text: 明石的海边气象，的确和别处不同。

en.t: The seaside atmosphere at Akashi was indeed unlike anywhere else.

units.source_text: 只是来往行人太多，不称源氏公子之心。

en.t: Only, there were too many people passing back and forth, which did not suit Prince Genji's feelings.

units.source_text: 明石道人的领地甚多，有的在海边，有的在山脚上。

en.t: The Akashi Novice had many estates, some by the sea and some at the foot of the mountains.

units.source_text: 海岸各处建有茅屋，可助四时游眺佳兴。

en.t: Thatched cottages had been built here and there along the coast, adding to the pleasure of outings and views in every season.

units.source_text: 适于冥想来世的山脚水边，建有庄严的佛堂，可供修行三昧。

en.t: By the waters at the mountain's foot, a place suited to meditating on the life to come, stood a solemn Buddhist hall where one could practice deep contemplation.

units.source_text: 为今世生活，则有良田沃土，秋收稻谷；为晚年安乐，则有仓廪无数，积蓄丰富。

en.t: For life in this world there were fine fields and fertile soil, yielding rice at the autumn harvest; for comfort in old age there were countless granaries and abundant stores.

units.source_text: 一年四季，都有种种设备，可以安乐度日。

en.t: In every season of the year, there were all sorts of arrangements that allowed one to pass the days in ease and comfort.

units.source_text: 为防近日的海啸，此时女眷均已迁居山边内宅中，源氏公子可在这海滨的本邸中从容息足。

en.t: To guard against the recent tsunamis, the women had all moved into the inner residence near the mountains, so Prince Genji could rest at leisure in this main house by the shore.
